curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: form plural nouns from their singular forms by adding -s or -es

mission.title: form plural nouns from their singular forms by adding -s or -es

interactions.retryHint: A word ending in s often takes -es.

interactions.prompt: Sort each plural by the ending added.

groups.label: add -es
groups.accessibleDescription: words formed by adding e s

interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then tap its ending group.
interactions.feedback: Great! Books and bags add -s; dishes and boxes add -es.
interactions.retryHint: Look closely at the last letters of each plural.

interactions.prompt: Which is the plural of brush?
interactions.retryHint: Brush ends in sh, so add -es.

interactions.prompt: Match each singular noun to its plural.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a singular noun, then its plural.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Every noun now names more than one.
interactions.retryHint: Try adding -s or -es to each singular noun.

interactions.prompt: Which sentence uses the correct plural?
interactions.feedback: Fantastic! Boxes is the correct plural of box.
interactions.retryHint: Box ends in x, so add -es.
